messages:
Maria P: Heads up  need a quick design decision on the request card trace affordances before we freeze the header for dev. Can we pick consistent wording + keyboard flows?

Josh D: Figma link posted. My proposal: compact request card header shows status dot, short id, elapsed time, and two icon actions on hover: copy corrID (clipboard icon) and download (arrow icon). Download opens a tiny menu with JSON/CSV.

Sam K: Implementation constraints: avoid heavy DOM for long lists. We'll virtualize rows and only mount the expanded trace when user expands or clicks download. Keyboard: space/enter to expand, enter on download menu item should start file download.

Nora A11y: A few accessibility points:
- The copy corrID should be a button with aria-label="Copy correlation ID for request <short-id>".
- The download control must be accessible via keyboard and present role="menu"/menuitem semantics if it is a popup.
- When expansion happens, focus should move to the first focusable element in the panel and we should set aria-live polite to announce the panel opened e.g., "Trace details opened for request abc123".

Nora A11y: Also color contrast: small status dot alone is not sufficient. Add a textual status in small caps for screen reader users or at least `aria-hidden` dot + visible label.

Lily QA: Test cases to cover: copy corrID from collapsed card, copy corrID from expanded view, keyboard nav: tab to card -> press Enter to expand -> focus lands in panel -> Shift+Tab moves back to header. Download behavior: filename includes corrID and timestamp. Bulk export in top bar must only export selected items and respect active filters.

Maria P: Copy phrasing debate: "Download trace (JSON)" vs "Export trace". Non-technical PMs prefer "Download" when it's a file, but engineers like "Export" for broader formats. Leaning toward "Download" with format suffix.

Josh D: Agreed: keep header terse. Use icon + tooltip "Download trace (JSON)". For the popup use explicit items: "Download trace (JSON)", "Download trace (CSV)". Avoid ambiguous "snapshot" word.

Sam K: Backend will expose `GET /api/v1/traces/{id}?format=json` and `?format=csv`. Frontend triggers a streaming download; no large client-side serialization. We'll add an ETag so repeated downloads are cached by the CDN.

ci-bot: CI:feat/trace-download started 6a7 test-run. Artifact with sample traces available at /artifacts/trace-samples.zip

Nora A11y: One more nit: copy-to-clipboard success should be announced with polite live region: "Correlation ID copied" and not rely solely on a tooltip. Tooltips aren't accessible to keyboard-only/screen reader users.

Maria P: Decision summary: per-card compact header with two action buttons: Copy correlation ID (aria-labeled) and Download trace (opens menu with JSON/CSV explicitly). Focus management: expand lands focus inside panel; expansion announced with polite live region. Download filename pattern: redwood-trace-<corrID>-<iso-date>.json. Josh will update Figma and artifacts. Lily will add QA checklist and post a test matrix. Sam to version backend endpoints and add ETag. I'll include accessibility checklist in PR. :thumbsup:
